plan.armOrder: left rotation by round-1; identical case order in every arm within a round
plan.inputOrder: five fixed cases, left rotation by round-1
plan.consumption: Existing release worker: complete SVG UTF8 + receipt JSON inside API timing; complete SHA256 fingerprints outside timing. Independent fresh GC memory workers.
plan.receiptPolicy: Implementation changes @22 to @23 intentionally alter receipts. Compare SVG separately; retain exact receipt, decision and certification differences without normalizing them away.
plan.cachePolicy: Existing layout-reference startup environment: off=text-spans + ELK_CACHE=0; normal=text-spans,position-cache + ELK_CACHE=1. indexed-layout intentionally excluded in both.
plan.limits: Five-case bounded experiment, not full27 qualification. Memory workers measure one post-warmup render/input and one corpus pass; reps15 applies to timing samples only.

cost.limits: Three rounds; five fixed inputs. Partial ratios are labelled incomplete. Receipt version/geometry changes are recorded independently of SVG; no universal ELK or full-release qualification claim.

limitations: Read-only analysis of existing fresh-worker results; no additional measurements.
Per-input peakHeapBytes is estimated absolute heap occupancy at GC boundaries, not incremental retained bytes.
peakRssBytes is the maximum across the worker lifetime, including import and warmup. The worker does not measure per-input RSS.
retainedGrowthBytes is clamped nonnegative by the worker. Ratios with a zero denominator are unavailable.
Three rounds and one post-warmup memory render per input per worker; timing reps do not multiply memory samples.
Partial ratios remain incomplete. This is bounded input evidence, not full release qualification.

browser.compression: sum of each fetched file; gzip level 9; Brotli quality 11
browser.familyCost: default includes selected ELK; nativeSolver is the structural closure with the native solver, not proof of input eligibility; static excludes on-demand dependencies; HTML5 tables and fallback dependencies are additional

limits: Five-input ablation is not the previous 27-input release qualification.
Allocation is GC-boundary estimated, not exact allocator instrumentation.
A/A controls and all adverse rounds are retained; no latency or universal allocation claim.
Full raw snapshots and worker results are preserved in the accompanying local evidence archive; repeated certificates omitted from this checked-in summary.
